description: This file defines an interface for a grain that manages counters with various asynchronous operations, including updating, resetting, retrieving tentative and confirmed states, and confirming events. It is part of the TestGrainInterfaces namespace, indicating it's a shared interface used in an Orleans-based actor system.

classes.name: ICountersGrain
classes.description: Interface for a counters grain that supports operations like adding, resetting, and retrieving counter states.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Updates the counter for the specified key by a given amount, optionally waiting for confirmation.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets all counters to zero, optionally waiting for confirmation.

methods.name: GetTentativeCount
methods.description: Retrieves the tentative value of the counter for the specified key.

methods.name: GetTentativeState
methods.description: Retrieves the tentative state of all counters as a read-only dictionary.

methods.name: GetConfirmedState
methods.description: Retrieves the confirmed state of all counters as a read-only dictionary.

methods.name: ConfirmAllPreviouslyRaisedEvents
methods.description: Confirms all previously raised events for the counters.
